config.name: Nitu Didi
config.subtitle: From Delhi & Chandigarh to Sydney, Nova Scotia — 15 days of cherished moments leading to your special day 💛
config.footer: Made with love · From Chandigarh, all the way to Nova Scotia 💛

memories.title: Little Beginnings in Delhi
memories.story: 4th November, 1994: The day Nitu Didi (aka Dr. Nitishikha Sharma) was born. Being the first child of the family she was obviously the most loved human in the universe at that time.

memories.title: Different styles same swag!
memories.story: Here you see our Nitu in different outfits but each one in increasing order of AURA. She has been surrounded by paparazzi since her birth.

memories.title: Photogenic since birth
memories.story: Posing has always been a strong point of doctor sahiba, even a lack of hair didn't undo the look.
memories.yearsAgo: Putting today's star babies to shame

memories.title: Nana Nani's Favourite!
memories.story: Watching you pursue dentistry with such dedication was incredible. Bringing comfort, relieving pain, and crafting confident smiles has always been your gift.

memories.title: Nana Nani's Favourite! part 2
memories.story: Finding calm amidst life's hustle. Your journey into yoga isn't just about asanas; it's the peaceful energy and mindfulness you radiate wherever you go.

memories.title: Chai, Talks & Siblings Bonds
memories.story: Unplanned late-night conversations over hot tea, sharing dreams, secrets, and ridiculous jokes that only the two of us would ever understand.

memories.title: Braving New Horizons
memories.story: Packing dreams across oceans! Moving across the globe takes immense courage, and you made Sydney, Nova Scotia feel like home with your sheer grace.

memories.title: Atlantic Breezes & Island Life
memories.story: Sydney, Nova Scotia with its rugged coasts and tranquil skies. Even across thousands of miles and time zones, you make the distance feel small.

memories.title: Inspiring at the YMCA
memories.story: Guiding Sydney's community toward health and balance every week at the YMCA. You touch so many lives with your gentle instruction and encouraging spirit.

memories.title: The Culinary Experiments
memories.story: Remembering favorite home-cooked meals, treats from Delhi and Chandigarh, and recreate-at-home attempts. Food tastes best when shared with family.

memories.title: Unshakeable Strength
memories.story: No matter what challenges life presented, your poise, resilience, and calm optimism have always been an anchor for all of us.

memories.title: Celebrations Across Oceans
memories.story: Even when miles apart during festivals and milestones, video calls and thoughtful messages keep our family bond tighter than ever.

memories.title: The Fun & Quirky Side
memories.story: Behind the accomplished doctor and zen yoga teacher is the sister with the goofy laugh, spontaneous dance moves, and funniest expressions.

memories.title: The Eve of Another Wonderful Year
memories.story: Looking back on 14 days of memories, every single one proves how lucky I am to have you as my Didi. Tomorrow is all about celebrating you!

memories.title: Happy Birthday, Nitu Didi! 🎂
memories.story: Today is your day! Dr. Nitishikha Sharma — compassionate healer, soul-stirring yoga teacher, and the best big sister anyone could ever dream of having.

exclusives.title: A Lifetime of Inspiration
exclusives.story: Growing up ten years behind you meant having a beacon to look up to every step of the way. Thank you for showing me what courage and kindness look like in practice.

exclusives.title: From CHD to Sydney with Love
exclusives.story: The miles between Chandigarh and Nova Scotia disappear whenever we talk. Distance only magnifies how precious each family moment is.

exclusives.title: Wishes for the Year Ahead
exclusives.story: May this year bring you thriving wellness, deep peace on the mat, glowing smiles in your clinic, and all the happiness your golden heart deserves!
